title: FungiScope - A Global Emerging Fungal Infection Registry
official: FungiScope - A Global Emerging Fungal Infection Registry
summary: The objective of this registry is to broaden the knowledge on epidemiology, diagnostic procedures and clinical course of emerging invasive fungal infections.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Cultural, histopathological, antigen or DNA evidence of invasive fungal infection

Exclusion Criteria:

* Infection due to Candida spp., Cryptococcus neoformans, Pneumocystis jiroveci
* Endemic fungal infection such as coccidioidomycosis or histoplasmosis
* Colonisation or other non-invasive infection
